title: Melville Research Bench
description: A research bench for reading, annotating and comparing Herman Melville's Billy Budd and his short tales in their versions: the manuscript's states of revision, the editions made from it, and the magazine and book texts of the tales. A research project of David M. Berry and Michael Jonik (University of Sussex), built on bench-kit. The texts are read at runtime from the Melville Electronic Library's TEI (github.com/performant-software/mel-website); none of MEL's transcription or encoding is included in this record. The manuscript is in the Houghton Library, Harvard University: Herman Melville papers (MS Am 188-188.6), Box 19, Volume 2, MS Am 188 (363). The record includes web derivatives of the manuscript's 449 leaves (img/leaves/), made from Harvard's IIIF image service and reproduced with the permission of the Houghton Library, Harvard University (granted 30 October 2026, for non-commercial research and teaching); img/leaves/provenance.csv gives each file's archival location, Houghton's folio and Harvard's sequence, and its source URLs.
